title: Airbnb Webhook Event
description: The envelope schema for all webhook event notifications sent by the Airbnb platform to partner endpoints, including event metadata and typed payloads.

event_id.description: A unique identifier for this webhook event, used for idempotency and deduplication.

event_type.description: The type of event that triggered the webhook notification.

timestamp.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

api_version.description: The API version used for the webhook payload format.

data.description: The event-specific payload data. Structure varies by event_type.
